# Hand metrics of the SEC-DED-DAEC code (generated by model/gen_daec.py)

Syndrome = encoder network on the received data, XOR the received check bits (+1 XOR level).

| Encoder IMPL | Structure | 2-input XORs | Logic depth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | behavioural reduction (synthesis decides) | 89 before sharing | - |
| 1 | flat XOR expression per row | 89 | 13 |
| 2 | common sub-expression elimination | 71 | 4 |
| 3 | balanced 2-input XOR tree per row | 89 | 4 |

| Correction logic | Seven-input comparators | Literals | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hsiao, comparators (ecc_corr_cmp) | 39 | 273 | ce = OR of the 39 flips |
| SEC-DED-DAEC, comparators (daec_corr_cmp) | 39 + 38 | 539 | flip[j] = single(j) or adjacent(j-1,j) or adjacent(j,j+1) |

Paper (Table 1): syndrome generator 96 two-input XORs, depth 4 - the same as the Hsiao code; the extra cost is in the corrector.
Test vectors: 54204 (46 data words x (1 clean + 39 single + 741 double) + 2 x 9139 triples).
